files.README.md:
# typescript-sql-postgresql-conversions-dtos

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: entities, repositories and services with SQL. It does not create or migrate the database.

## Settings

- Database: postgresql; code: asynchronous (every method returns a Promise).
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no class for.
- Services: take and return DTOs (interfaces).
- Transactions: one transaction per service operation, committed when it ends.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/database.ts        the database: DATABASE_URL, through its driver, and the calls that run SQL
src/errors.ts          NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationFailedError: no HTTP codes
src/unit-of-work.ts    the repositories of every table, and the transaction of each operation
src/entities/          one entity per table
src/repositories/      one repository per table
src/services/          one service per table
test/                  repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json     what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run build
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://app:app@localhost:5432/app npm test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

/** The tables of the test database, as the schema DB2CRUD read has them. */

/** Removes every table, so the database starts empty. */
export const DROP: string[] = [
  'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "product_tags" CASCADE',
  'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "tags" CASCADE',
  'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "products" CASCADE',
  'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "categories" CASCADE',
  'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "customers" CASCADE',
]

/** Creates every table, in an order the database accepts. */
export const CREATE: string[] = [
  'CREATE TABLE "customers" (
  "id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "email" VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("email")
)',
  'CREATE TABLE "categories" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "name" VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("name")
)',
  'CREATE TABLE "products" (
  "id" BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  "price" NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
  "status" VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'live')),
  FOREIGN KEY ("category_id") REFERENCES "categories" ("id")
)',
  'CREATE TABLE "tags" (
  "id" INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY NOT NULL,
  "label" VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)',
  'CREATE TABLE "product_tags" (
  "product_id" BIGINT NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "tag_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "products" ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("tag_id") REFERENCES "tags" ("id")
)',
]
